aboutMe.desc: With over 14 years of designing and delivering business-driven, user-centered digital solutions, including extensive hands-on work in Generative AI, cloud platforms, and modern engineering practices, I am passionate about crafting product roadmaps, actively contributing to codebases, and mentoring engineers on responsible best practices and scalable design patterns. Over the years, I've worked across multicultural, multidisciplinary environments to co-create AI solutions, run hackathons, and lead innovation sprints that bridged business needs with emerging technologies. My goal is to shape and champion the journey of driving innovation while ensuring alignment with business goals, technical excellence, and responsible AI principles
aboutMe.quote: Great architecture isn't just scalable. It's thoughtful, ethical, and built for the people who use it.
